name: alert
title: Alert
description: A status banner — upstream's two variants plus our three extra status tones (COL-12); buttons inside a status alert hover in the family's own tint and ink, never white.

meta.whenToUse: Persistent, in-page status messages — info, success, warning, or error context tied to surrounding content.
meta.whenNotToUse: Transient feedback after a user action — use a toast instead.
